release_gates.note: Allowlisted source export and exclusions are machine-checkable.
Checks are implemented; the exact clean final-candidate commit must be replayed and durable outputs preserved before its local tag is published.
The fourteen cited entries were checked on 2026-08-28; the version-sensitive Fox--Hunter and Campos--Fox--Schildkraut preprints are pinned to v1 and must be rechecked before the release freeze.
A clean build exists locally; after the DOI metadata is inserted, the PDF must be rebuilt and checked from the exact final-candidate commit before its local tag is published.

Thirteen canonical manifests record exactly 67 accepted executions: two GPU verify1 runs, two CPU-criterion runs, and one stand-alone separate-source verifier run per claim, plus two high-range witnesses. The manifests bind the clean qualification-source commit and exact source hashes.

The authenticated archive contains 515 rows: 514 checkpoint-and-journal rows and checkpoint-only recovery for chunk 7. It preserves 498 per-chunk histograms for chunks 18--515 and the aggregate re-scan for chunks 1--17 without inventing unavailable per-chunk streams.
The scanner and separate-source CPU sieve produced byte-identical ordered streams on all 515 chunks: 48,823,489 primes and 535,628,154 bytes.
The SM120 regression passed on the clean qualification-source commit; the manifest binds its commit and tree, source and binary hashes, CUDA/compiler/driver/GPU identities, command, and raw streams.
The author must choose licences for code, paper/data, and resolve redistribution of third-party objects.

At the final transition, after the other gates pass and the DOI metadata is final, stage the release-form STATUS (archived_release, citable_release true, all gates passed). For this gate, passed means that the metadata and staged payload are ready for the inner-freeze transaction; it does not attest a published tag, an uploaded archive, or an out-of-repository deposit receipt. Run freeze_release.py create; only if it succeeds, stage MANIFEST.sha256, commit, and create the local tag. A create failure must not be committed or published. The post-tag deposit comparison and receipt remain outside the repository and are not embedded evidence for this gate.
